Messages.Author: Alex Broadhead
Messages.Body:
Howdy,

I see that in the latest update to WW web pages an expanded V:EKN
section has been added. Among the additions (at least I never noticed
it before) is a set of V:EKN regions, presumably for qualification
purposes?

Anyway, apparently you're out of luck if you're from Delaware,
Wyoming, or the Dakotas. Or are they the 'Secret Region'? Given that
some of those states have cities with Princes, I'm sure they'll need
inclusion...

Hope that helps,
Alex

Messages.Author: Alex Broadhead
Messages.Body:
Howdy LSJ,

Please excuse the top posting, but I'm not so much replying to my own
message as just trying to draw attention to it. I guess I was either
too subtle before, or this isn't the right place to address this, but
there are still four states missing from the V:EKN regions.

Oh, and also, as far as I can tell Dreams of the Sphinx was not
reprinted in CE, so it's impossible that it's most recent text
migration is in that set, as is indicated in the text migrations list.
I think it should be FN?

Hope that helps,
Alex
